caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of 25 square sections arranged in a 5 x 5 grid, each square bordered by a red and white design. Each square contains a distinct motif featuring a combination of floral arrangements, birds, baskets, and decorative objects, with the dominant colors being red, green, blue, yellow, and brown. The birds are shown in various poses, often perched amid foliage or near flowers and fruit, and some are blue while others are shades of brown. The floral and fruit motifs consist of various combinations of red, pink, blue, and yellow flowers with green stems and leaves, as well as bowls or vases in blue or yellow. Several squares feature stars or cross-like decorations mingled with greenery and flowers. The overall quilt is framed with a wavy red border inside a broader green border, all set against a cream or off-white background. The arrangement and detailing are symmetrical, with each square containing intricate and colorful patterns.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
